name: Akaysha Energy
description: Akaysha Energy develops, owns and operates large grid-scale battery storage projects for Australia's electricity market, employs over 210 staff, and is expanding into Germany, Japan and the US.
note: Acquired by BlackRock (2022); stake sale reportedly considered (Jan 2026)

name: TS Communities
description: TS Communities, Tishman Speyer's affordable housing arm, builds income-restricted rental apartments for lower-income New York households, including the planned 2,050-unit Edgemere Commons neighborhood in Queens.

name: SK geo centric
description: SK Geo Centric, a petrochemical subsidiary of South Korea's SK Innovation, makes polymers for manufacturers and is building an Ulsan complex to recycle about 320,000 tonnes of plastic waste yearly.
note: Renamed from SK Global Chemical (2021)

name: Keurig Dr Pepper
description: Keurig Dr Pepper sells soft drinks, coffee brewers and coffee pods to retailers and consumers, and expects about $26 billion of 2026 sales after buying JDE Peet's.
note: Acquired JDE Peet's (April 2026); plans to split into separate beverage and coffee companies

name: Level 3 Financing
description: Level 3 Financing, a wholly owned subsidiary of Lumen Technologies, issues notes to institutional investors to fund Lumen's networking business, including $2 billion of first lien notes in 2025.

name: Hometap
description: Hometap is a Boston fintech that gives US homeowners cash in exchange for a share of their home's future value, with no monthly payments, and has served over 26,000 homeowners.

name: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals
description: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals develops and sells RNA interference medicines, including Amvuttra for transthyretin amyloidosis, to patients and healthcare systems worldwide, with 2025 revenue of about $3.7 billion.

name: Aurora
description: Aurora Innovation develops self-driving software and hardware for Class 8 trucks, running driverless freight routes in Texas for shippers and carriers, and targets 200 driverless trucks by end-2026.

name: Aircastle
description: Aircastle buys and leases commercial jet aircraft to airlines, owning and managing 282 aircraft leased to 76 lessees in 45 countries as of February 2026.

name: Mercuria
description: Mercuria Energy Group is a privately held Geneva commodity trader that trades oil, gas and power with producers, utilities and industrial buyers, reporting $174 billion revenue in 2022.

name: Target
description: Target is a Minneapolis-based general merchandise retailer serving US shoppers through more than 2,000 stores and online, and plans more than 30 new stores in 2026.

name: Hithium Energy Storage
description: Hithium makes lithium iron phosphate batteries and complete energy storage systems for utilities and grid-storage developers, and ranked third globally in energy storage battery shipments in 2024.

name: Jupiter Power
description: Jupiter Power develops, owns and operates utility-scale battery storage projects serving grid operators and utilities in Texas and other US markets, with offices in Austin, Houston and Chicago.

name: Pernod
description: Pernod Ricard produces and sells spirits and wines such as Absolut, Jameson and Ballantine's to distributors, retailers and bars in over 160 countries, employing about 18,500 people.
